title: Spellcasting Sorcerer
description: A robed sorcerer with a mechanical helmet and glowing rings sits cross-legged, casting a spell over a bubbling cauldron filled with glowing orbs. Behind him rises a massive mound of black insects or artifacts, with floating scrolls labeled 'EQUIP MORE SPELLS' and bug diagrams nearby.
prompt: A robed sorcerer wearing a complex mechanical helmet with floating golden rings sits cross-legged casting a spell, hands extended over a bubbling cauldron filled with glowing golden orbs and rising steam. A massive dark mound of black insects or artifacts towers behind him, with several floating scrolls nearby including one that reads 'EQUIP MORE SPELLS' and others showing bug diagrams, in a detailed black and white ink style with glowing gold accents and floating particles
